column1: # with "<sample>_".
# Start/End define the region passed to bamsort_alignment_reads_host.py.
#   - For alt cassettes: M-overlap = inclusion
#   - For "<gene>_constant" rows: a downstream constant exon used as a
#     denominator / "any spliced mRNA" marker; exclusion isn't meaningful here.
# Strand and Upstream/Downstream exons are used by BRIE2 GFF builder
# (build_brie_gff_targets.py); flanks are the adjacent annotated exons. Leave
# BRIE2 columns blank for genes you don't intend to test for splicing.
# PTPRC: primer in exon 2 (chr1:56060491-56060515 +). The CD45 variable block
# is Ensembl canonical exons 4
# defines the RA -> RO transition. Constant marker is exon 9
# downstream of the block that is present in every transcript.
# IL7R: primer in exon 5 (chr6:35650836-35650860 +); skipping the TM exon
# (full-length IL7R-202 exon 6
# encodes the aa 245-263 transmembrane helix) produces soluble IL7R. The
# 35652752-35652827 exon just downstream encodes the juxtamembrane/cytoplasmic
# region (aa 267-292) and is used here as the downstream flank. Constant marker
# BCL2L1: primer at chr10:66965518-66965539 lies INSIDE the 189-nt cassette
# that is retained in BCL-xL but spliced out in BCL-xS via an alternative 5'
# donor near +66965682. Reads at this primer can only originate from BCL-xL
# transcripts -- BCL-xS has no primer binding site -- so this target cannot
# distinguish the two isoforms.
